items.title: Lok Sabha passes bill to increase Supreme Court judges' strength from 34 to 38
items.summary: The Lok Sabha has passed a bill to expand the sanctioned strength of Supreme Court judges, including the Chief Justice of India (CJI), from 34 to 38.

or.title: ସୁପ୍ରିମକୋର୍ଟ ବିଚାରପତିଙ୍କ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ୩୪ ରୁ ୩୮ କୁ ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇଁ ଲୋକସଭାରେ ବିଲ୍ ପାରିତ
or.summary: ଭାରତର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ବିଚାରପତି (CJI) ଙ୍କ ସମେତ ସୁପ୍ରିମକୋର୍ଟର ଅନୁମୋଦିତ ବିଚାରପତି ସଂଖ୍ୟା ୩୪ ରୁ ୩୮ କୁ ବୃଦ୍ଧି କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଲୋକସଭାରେ ଏକ ବିଲ୍ ପାରିତ ହୋଇଛି।

items.title: India achieves 99.92% banking coverage across inhabited villages
items.summary: India has attained near-universal banking accessibility, with 99.92% of inhabited villages across the country now having access to formal banking services.

or.title: ଭାରତର ୯୯.୯୨% ବସବାସପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଗ୍ରାମରେ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କିଙ୍ଗ୍ ସେବା ପହଞ୍ଚିଲା
or.summary: ଦେଶର ୯୯.୯୨% ବସବାସପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଗ୍ରାମରେ ଆନୁଷ୍ଠାନିକ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କିଙ୍ଗ୍ ସେବା ଉପଲବ୍ଧ ହେବା ସହ ଭାରତ ପ୍ରାୟ-ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କିଙ୍ଗ୍ ସୁବିଧା ହାସଲ କରିଛି।

items.title: FCNR(B) deposits nearly double to USD 60.5 billion after RBI relaxation
items.summary: Foreign Currency Non-Resident (Bank) deposits nearly doubled to reach USD 60.5 billion following regulatory relaxations by the Reserve Bank of India, with HSBC, SBI, and ICICI leading inflows.

or.title: ଆରବିଆଇ କୋହଳ ନୀତି ପରେ FCNR(B) ଜମା ୬୦.୫ ବିଲିୟନ ଡଲାରରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଲା
or.summary: ଭାରତୀୟ ରିଜର୍ଭ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କର ନିୟମାବଳୀ କୋହଳ ପରେ ବୈଦେଶିକ ମୁଦ୍ରା ଅଣ-ନିବାସୀ (ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ) ଜମା ପ୍ରାୟ ଦ୍ୱିଗୁଣିତ ହୋଇ ୬୦.୫ ବିଲିୟନ ଡଲାରରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଛି।

items.title: RBI sells $14.9 billion during Jan-May to check rupee volatility
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) sold $14.9 billion in foreign exchange between January and May to mitigate excess volatility in the Indian Rupee.

or.title: ଟଙ୍କାର ଅସ୍ଥିରତା ରୋକିବାକୁ ଜାନୁଆରୀ-ମେ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଆରବିଆଇ ୧୪.୯ ବିଲିୟନ ଡଲାର ବିକ୍ରି କଲା

items.title: Adani Group proposes ₹1 Trillion AI Data Centre in Odisha
items.summary: The Adani Group has proposed an investment of ₹1 trillion to set up an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Data Centre project in Odisha and has sought land allocation.

items.title: Odisha seeks UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage tag for Puri Rath Yatra
items.summary: The Government of Odisha has initiated steps to seek a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage tag for the annual Puri Rath Yatra festival.

or.title: ପୁରୀ ରଥଯାତ୍ରା ପାଇଁ ୟୁନେସ୍କୋ ଐତିହ୍ୟ ମାନ୍ୟତା ଦାବି କଲା ଓଡ଼ିଶା

items.title: Supreme Court permits Calcutta HC to requisition judges from Jharkhand and Odisha
items.summary: The Supreme Court of India has allowed the Calcutta High Court to requisition judges from the High Courts of Jharkhand and Odisha to handle case backlogs.
